description: Get what reading one file delivered by a public scan found (a download, a file link, a command put on the clipboard, or a file inside one of those): type, size and hashes, verdict and its reasons, files inside it, Windows program details (signer, version information, compiler, build time, imports, debug file), capabilities with ATT&CK techniques, matching rules, antivirus detection names, embedded URLs and identifiers that tie it to other files. sha256 is the file's SHA-256 (64 hex characters).
name: get_file_analysis
title: Get File Analysis
